clause: Import/export raster feature preservation + capability-loss reporting [STU-RAS-043]

scope.summary: Ensure round-trip preservation of alpha channels, spot channels, layer groups, masks, adjustment/live-filter/fill layers, placed-asset links, and layer effects across import and export wherever the target format supports them (14.13). Where a capability is lost on flatten/export, report it as inspectable state rather than dropping it silently. Backend behavior + inspectable capability-loss report consumed by the export surface.
acceptance_criteria: capability loss reported as inspectable state, never silent
proof_targets: layered round-trip preservation + capability-loss report test
expected_tests: live: export a document with masks + adjustment layers + effects to a layered format and re-import; confirm the non-destructive structure survives
live: flatten to a format that cannot hold layers and confirm a capability-loss report is produced (not a silent drop)
test: spot/alpha channels + placed-asset links preserved where supported

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Silent loss of layers/masks/effects on export; operators lose non-destructive structure without warning.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
